remarks: Set in the premier Newfield neighborhood near shopping & the Sterling Farms Golf Course, this ranch-style home offers refined luxury on a park-like 1 acre plus property with mature plantings, a level lawn, & a tranquil backyard setting. The home features Hardie board siding with stone fascia, copper gutters, Anderson windows, & a bright open layout. A custom slate fireplace highlights the main living area, with sliders leading to a large stone patio. The remodeled designer kitchen offers Anagre wood cabinetry, jet-black granite countertops, a center island, & high-end appliances. The kitchen flows into the dining area & cathedral-ceiling living room with built-ins, & a striking steel-framed wall of custom Andersen windows overlooking the backyard & lake. A four-season sunroom provides a flexible space or a potential 4th bedroom & opens to a 2nd flagstone patio. The upper level includes 2 spacious bedrooms & 2 full baths, highlighted by an expansive primary suite with balcony access, 2 custom walk-in closets, & a luxurious marble bath with soaking tub, & oversized glass shower. The lower level features a 3rd bedroom with built-ins, a custom tiled bath, sitting area, office space, & a separate laundry/mudroom. Outdoor living is enhanced by an oversized stone patio with an outdoor kitchen, Viking gas grill, & lava glass fire pit. The backyard overlooks a crystal-clear, aerated lake with a private fountain & screened gazebo.
